0022600178.text: The Pacers are 2-6 on a five-game losing streak, 0-4 at home and 2-2 on the road, and they are without Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, Obi Toppin, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, while Kelly Oubre Jr. is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision. The Grizzlies are 6-1 and 2nd in the West, 0.5 games back in the Southwest, and they lost their most recent game, with Scotty Pippen Jr. out and Quinten Post day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. Neither team has played the other this season, and Indiana lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
